sources.entry: RhodeCode - Unify and simplify repository management for Git, Subversion, and Mercurial. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python

summary.name: RhodeCode
summary.one_liner: RhodeCode is a self-hosted source code management platform that unifies repository hosting, code review, and access control across Git, Subversion, and Mercurial.
use_cases: Host Git, Mercurial and Subversion repositories on one server
Run code review and pull requests on self-hosted infrastructure
Centralise repository permissions and audit trails
Migrate Subversion projects to Git gradually
Manage source control in air-gapped or regulated environments
Automate review workflows via webhooks and REST API
summary.what_it_does: RhodeCode provides one platform for Git, Subversion, and Mercurial repositories, with the same code review, workflow automation, and permission features across all three. Team collaboration includes inline comments, smart commits that trigger approvals and merges, and custom workflows. Workflow automation covers reviewer rules, event hooks and webhooks, and a full REST API. Permissions can be set at team, individual, or repository level, with IP restrictions and an immutable audit log. Authentication options listed are LDAP, AD, SAML 2.0, CAS, OAuth, and 2FA.
notable: Single platform hosting Git, Mercurial and Subversion with unified permissions
Community edition under AGPLv3; Enterprise Edition is commercial
Immutable audit log with 7-year retention and SIEM stream
Telemetry: none collected, instance never contacts RhodeCode
caveats: Enterprise Edition is commercial and licensed for a minimum of 10 seats
Enterprise Cloud managed tiers are paid: Starter $80, Team $180, Enterprise $600 per month
Community edition is self-supported; support with SLA is an Enterprise feature
